com.vector.cfg.automation.api.project

Interface IProjectHandlingApi

  • All Superinterfaces:
    IDynamicObjectAware

    @DynamicTarget(value={"com.vector.cfg.project.evs.pai.IUpdateVariantApiEntryPoint","com.vector.cfg.project.evs.pai.IImportVariantApiEntryPoint"})
 @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IProjectHandlingApi
extends IDynamicObjectAware
    IProjectHandlingApi provides methods for accessing the active project, for creating new projects and for opening existing projects.
    IProjectHandlingApi provides methods to access to the active project, for creating new projects and for opening existing projects.
    Accessing the Active Project
    The IProjectHandlingApi provides access to the active project. The active project is either (in descending order):
    • The last IProject instance activated with a Closure block
      • Stack-based - so multiple opened projects are possible and the last (inner) Closure block is used.
    • The passed project to a project task
    • Or the loaded project in the current DaVinci Configurator in an application task

    The figure describes the behavior to search for the active project of a script task.

    It is possible that there is no active project, e.g. no project was loaded.

    You can switch the active project, by calling the with(Closure) method on an IProject instance. 

     
 // Retrieve theProject from other API like load a project
 IProject theProject = ...;
 theProject.with {
     // Now theProject is the new active project inside of this closure
 }

    To access the active project you can use the activeProject(Closure) and getActiveProject() methods.

      • createProject

        @PublishedMethod
IProjectRef createProject(@VDelegatesToWithClosureParam(value=ICreateProjectApi.class)
                                            groovy.lang.Closure<?> code)
        createProject(Closure) creates a new project as specified by the given Closure which is delegated to the ICreateProjectApi.
        The method createProject(Closure) creates a new project as specified by the given Closure. Inside the closure the ICreateProjectApi is available.

        The new project is not opened and usable until IProjectRef.openProject(Closure) is called on the returned IProjectRef.

        Parameters:
        code - the code (a Closure) specifying the new project's settings using the ICreateProjectApi
        Returns:
        an IProjectRef (handle to the newly created project, never null)

      • openProject

        @PublishedMethod
<T> T openProject(@Nonnull
                                    java.lang.Object dpaFile,
                                    @VDelegatesToWithClosureParam(value=IProject.class)
                                    groovy.lang.Closure<T> code)
        openProject(Object, Closure) opens the project at the given .dpa file location, delegates the given code to the opened IProject and closes the project.
        You can open an existing DaVinci Configurator Dpa project with the automation interface.

        The method openProject(Object, Closure) opens the project at the given .dpa file location, delegates the given code to the opened IProject.

        The project is automatically closed after leaving the Closure code of the openProject(Object, Closure) method.

        The Object given as .dpa file is converted to Path using ScriptConverters.TO_SCRIPT_PATH

        Note: When loading a dpa file, which got created with a different SIP, the system does not try to migrate this project. The system rather tries to open the project without a migration.
        Parameters:
        dpaFile - the .dpa file to be opened
        code - the code (a Closure) to be executed on the opened IProject

      • parameterizeArxmlFileLoad

        @PublishedMethod
IProjectRef parameterizeArxmlFileLoad(@VDelegatesToWithClosureParam(value=IOpenArxmlFilesProjectApi.class)
                                                        groovy.lang.Closure<?> code)
        parameterizeArxmlFileLoad(Closure) returns a handle on a slim project of .arxml files specified by the given Closure.
        The method parameterizeArxmlFileLoad(Closure) allows to load multiple arxml files into a temporary project. The given Closure is used to customize the project's opening procedure by the IOpenArxmlFilesProjectApi.

        The arxml file project is not opened until openProject() is called on the returned IProjectRef.

        Parameters:
        code - the code (a Closure) specifying which project to be opened and how to open it using the IOpenArxmlFilesProjectApi
        Returns:
        an IProjectRef (handle to the newly opened project, never null)
        See Also:
        IOpenArxmlFilesProjectApi

      • parameterizeProjectLoad

        @PublishedMethod
IProjectRef parameterizeProjectLoad(@VDelegatesToWithClosureParam(value=IOpenDpaProjectApi.class)
                                                      groovy.lang.Closure<?> code)
        parameterizeProjectLoad(Closure) returns a handle on the project specified by the given Closure.

        Parameterized Project Load

        You can also configure how a Dpa project is loaded, e.g. by disabling the generators. The method parameterizeProjectLoad(Closure) returns a handle on the project specified by the given Closure. Using the IOpenDpaProjectApi, the Closure may further customize the project's opening procedure.

        The project is not opened until openProject() is called on the returned IProjectRef.

        Parameters:
        code - the code (a Closure) specifying which project to be opened and how to open it using the IOpenProjectApi
        Returns:
        an IProjectRef (handle to the newly opened project, never null)
